acquisition_method.evidence: For data independent acquisition (DIA) measurements, a staggered window approach was used.
For data dependent acquisition (DDA) measurements, a full MS1 scan was recorded every 3 sec at 120,000 resolution with standard AGC target and automatic IT from 375 to 1500 m/z.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: alkylated with 15 mM iodoacetamide for 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark

alkylation_reagent.evidence: alkylated with 15 mM iodoacetamide for 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark

cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples prepared to assess mistranslation frequency were digested with 5 ng/μL LysC (Wako Chemicals)
samples prepared for whole proteome and phosphoproteome analysis were digested with a combination of 5 ng/μL trypsin (Promega) with 5 ng/μL LysC

collision_energy.evidence: One DIA cycle contained 30 windows of 24 m/z size at 30,000 resolution, 33% normalized collision energy (NCE) higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD)
MS2 scans were recorded at 30,000 resolution, 30% NCE HCD, 1.6 m/z isolation window
One DIA cycle contained 30 windows of 24 m/z size at 50,000 resolution, 31% NCE HCD, default charge state 3 and AGC target of 1000%.
MS2 scans were recorded at 50,000 resolution, 30% NCE HCD, 1.6 m/z isolation window

enrichment_method.evidence: phosphopeptides were enriched with Fe3+-NTA magnetic beads (PureCube Fe-NTA MagBeads, Cube Biotech)

fractionation_method.evidence: For gas phase fractionated (GPF) samples, eight injections of a pooled sample covering 100 m/z of the total scan range per injection with 25 windows of 4 m/z isolation width were performed.

instrument.evidence: analyzed on an Orbitrap Eclipse Mass Spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific)

ionization_type.evidence: Peptides were resuspended in 4% ACN, 3% FA and analyzed on an Orbitrap Eclipse Mass Spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific) equipped with an Easy1200 nanoLC system

labeling.evidence: inferred: DIA files were searched and quantified with DIA-NN v2.1.0

ptm.evidence: variable modifications of methionine oxidation (15.9949 Da)
variable modifications of serine, threonine and tyrosine phosphorylation (79.9663 Da)
modifications: monohydroxylated residue; iodoacetamide derivatized residue

reduction_concentration.evidence: Proteins were reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol for 30 minutes at 55°C

reduction_reagent.evidence: Proteins were reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol for 30 minutes at 55°C
